d: Job Title: Estimation Engineer – Civil (EPC, LFC,SFC Projects Saudi Aramco)

The Estimation Engineer – Civil is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects in Saudi Aramco. The role includes detailed quantity take-offs, cost estimation, tender schedule preparation, manpower planning, and post-award support to ensure smooth transition from tendering to project execution while protecting commercial interests.
q: Minimum 5–10 years experience in EPC estimation
Strong experience in civil, structural, and architectural works
Proficiency in Excel and estimation tools
Strong analytical and cost evaluation skills
Ability to prepare schedules and manpower plans
Ability to work under tight deadlines
Knowledge of Saudi market rates and suppliers
Familiarity with Primavera P6 or MS Project
Certification in cost engineering is a plus
Saudi Arabia(office-based with occasional site visits)
